title: Connect your data to an API
subtitle: Map table columns to request parameters, inspect a real response and create an enriched dataset.

step1.label: Input
step1.title: Select a dataset
step1.description: Choose the local table whose rows will be enriched.

step2.label: Connection
step2.title: Choose an API endpoint
step2.description: Discover a registered service or enter a URL manually.
step2.noParameters: This endpoint has no declared query parameters.
step2.placeholderHelp: Use placeholders such as {example} to represent values from your table.
step2.locked: Select a source table to configure the endpoint.

step3.label: Request mapping
step3.title: Connect fields and test
step3.description: Map request parameters and validate the API response with the first row.
step3.mappingHelp: Choose the source column for each request value.
step3.responseHelp: Sample generated from the first source row.
step3.responseEmpty: Map a parameter to send a sample request.

step4.label: Output
step4.title: Build the enriched table
step4.description: Choose which response fields to keep and where to store them.
step4.fieldsHelp: Leave the JSON path empty to store the complete response.
step4.rowsHelp: Leave empty to process every row
step4.outputHelp: A new local table will be created

summary.title: Enrichment job
summary.tipText: Test 10 rows before processing the complete dataset.
